pages.lesson:
LESSON: BOOK WRITING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Book WRITING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Book WRITING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we handle books?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate ability to handle books appropriately in and out of class.
2. Arrange books properly in and out of class.
3. Enjoy participating in book handling activities in and out of class. arranging books in the book corner. their books and writing forcefully during a writing activity. their books properly.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate ability to handle books appropriately in and out of class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate ability to handle books appropriately in and out of class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Arrange books properly in and out of class.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to arrange books properly in and out of class. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Enjoy participating in book handling activities in and out of class. arranging books in the book corner. their books and writing forcefully during a writing activity. their books properly.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to enjoy participating in book handling activities in and out of class. arranging books in the book corner. their books and writing forcefully during a writing activity. their books properly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Book WRITING.
2. Explain Book WRITING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Book WRITING.
4. Show that you can: Demonstrate ability to handle books appropriately in and out of class.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Book WRITING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do we handle books?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Demonstrate ability to handle books appropriately in and out of class.
2. Arrange books properly in and out of class.
3. Enjoy participating in book handling activities in and out of class. arranging books in the book corner. their books and writing forcefully during a writing activity. their books properly.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
